title: An event page shows 'Location shared with members' when the host left the address visible, and its Event rich result has no address

source.ref: Site scan 2026-10-14 (scan nine, thread 'Site scan'), against origin/main eb26a01 and production.

detail: FILED 2026-10-14. THE CONSEQUENCE: on production 239 of 244 public upcoming events have no city, region or country; 147 of them carry a full visible street address in the free-text events.location column with hide_address=false (e.g. tg-veteran-community-conversation-2026-10-14: 'Municipal, 1722 S Coast Hwy, Oceanside, CA 92054'). publicPageWhere (lib/events/visible-location.ts:91) and the JSON-LD place builder (lib/jsonld.ts ~277-297) read only the venue row and events.city, never events.location, so the public page prints 'Location shared with members' and the Event JSON-LD emits a nameless Place with no address. Members cannot see where to go, and Google drops these events from Event rich results. THE FIX: when hide_address is false, fall back to events.location for the where-line and the JSON-LD (as publicVisibleLocation already does), and fall back to the host Space's city (146 of the 239 have one) for addressLocality.
